3 مُلَاقَطَةٌ A horse's lifting the legs all together in the pace called تَقْرِيب: (AO, K: *) or, in the pace called خَبَب, of a horse, it is similar to مُنَاقَلَةٌ. (JK.) ＝
-A2- Also, (K,) and ↓ لِقَاطٌ , (TA,) The being over against, or facing. (K, TA.) You say, دَارُهُ بِلِقَاطِ دَارِى His house is over against, or faces, my house. (Lh, K.) And لَقِيتُهُ لِقَاطاً I met him face to face. (IAar.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
